
================================================================
  YOUR SETUP
================================================================
  you        9 ms ping   480 fps   handler=soloRaw
  the rival  11 ms ping   480 fps   reactive, same speed
  frame      2.083 ms      flush step 2.083 ms
  your wire edge  1.0 ms one way, 2.0 ms both ways

  frame phase is the one thing you do not control, so it is swept.
  negative gap = you reached the server first.

  rival's grid vs yours            win   tie  lose   median gap
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  theirs 0.000 ms earlier           32     0     0    -0.994 ms
  theirs 0.260 ms earlier           32     0     0    -2.814 ms
  theirs 0.521 ms earlier           32     0     0    -2.556 ms
  theirs 0.781 ms earlier           32     0     0    -2.297 ms
  theirs 1.042 ms earlier           31     1     0    -2.036 ms
  theirs 1.302 ms earlier           32     0     0    -1.777 ms
  theirs 1.562 ms earlier           32     0     0    -1.516 ms
  theirs 1.823 ms earlier           32     0     0    -1.257 ms
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  across every phase               255     1     0

  you take the code in 99.6% of races (100.0% incl. ties)

  why -- and this is the part that is NOT like a detection head start:
    your 2.0 ms edge is two separate legs, and only one of them
    is subject to the frame clock.

      inbound   1.0 ms  the announcement reaches you sooner.
                        QUANTISED -- it only pays if it crosses
                        a 2.083 ms flush boundary.
      outbound  1.0 ms  your redeem flies home faster.
                        NOT quantised -- it lands after the flush,
                        straight on the wire. phase cannot take it.

    that outbound half is why the gap at a 0 ms phase offset is
    1.0 ms and not zero: both clients flush at the same instant and
    your packet still gets there first. a ping edge always pays at
    least half. a detection edge can pay nothing at all.
  control -- pings swapped, you on 11 ms, them on 9 ms
  ----------------------------------------------------------------
  across every phase                 0     1   255
  you take the code in 0.0% of races
  inverts cleanly -- the result above is the ping, not the harness.
